meta.unit: JPY tn (or USD bn in the _usd fields)
meta.current_account_note: current_account = seasonally adjusted; current_account_nsa = not seasonally adjusted (原数値), same MoF table family, added 2026-08-11 at HanHan's request. + = current account surplus / net receipts.
meta.direct_investment_note: Not seasonally adjusted (MoF does not publish an SA version of FDI). Flow-consistent sign convention (updated 2026-08-11): residents' outward FDI is a capital outflow, sign-flipped to plot as a negative bar; non-residents' inward FDI is a capital inflow, plotted as-is (positive), matching the sign convention used elsewhere on this dashboard (outflow = negative, inflow = positive). direct_investment_balance = inward - outward (+ = net capital inflow to Japan).
meta.usd_note: _usd fields converted at each month's own USDJPY close (Yahoo Finance JPY=X, monthly), $bn = ¥tn * 1000 / rate — same conversion convention as mof_flows.json.
meta.source: Ministry of Finance Japan — official Balance of Payments trend-data CSVs (国際収支総括表 SA + NSA / 対外・対内直接投資総括表), monthly, revised basis (not the preliminary press-release PDF)
